name: cryptovision-pro
description: Next-Generation Cryptocurrency Intelligence & Market Analytics Platform

scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.build:api: npm run build:shared && npm run prisma:generate --workspace=@cryptovision/api && npm run build --workspace=@cryptovision/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=@cryptovision/web
scripts.postinstall: npm run build:shared && npm run prisma:generate
